news.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
news.summary: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.

news.title: Live news: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
news.summary: A fifth straight weekly decline would mark bitcoin’s joint third-longest losing streak, as oil rebounds and Apple’s margin warning adds to investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterms.

news.title: North Korea denies role in $6.4 billion Binance hack after FBI points to TraderTraitor
news.summary: The high-profile denial follows FBI alerts identifying North Korean-controlled wallet addresses tied to the largest cryptocurrency exploit in history.

news.title: NEAR governance approves proposal to cut token issuance ceiling to 1.6%
news.summary: NEAR's House of Stake passed HSP-029, which lowers the network's maximum annual issuance rate from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin pledges to cover all user losses after near $40 million hack
news.summary: Partners like Tether, Circle, and Chainalysis helped freeze $11M of the stolen assets.

news.title: Consensys launches cross-ledger settlement and routing stack for institutional networks
news.summary: Consensys launched a technology stack enabling banks to route and settle transactions across independent ledgers without moving assets.

news.title: Bitcoin’s latest chart signal looks a lot like the ones before its big crashes
news.summary: The Guppy Multiple Moving Average bands signal a bearish momentum, even as seasonality and post-midterm history lean bullish.

news.title: ARK buys $17M in Coinbase, Circle shares while trimming Bullish
news.summary: ARK Invest added Coinbase and Circle shares across two trading sessions while selling about $8 million in Bullish as crypto stocks declined.

news.title: Suspected EU crypto theft estimate rises to $133M: ZachXBT
news.summary: ZachXBT identified another $27 million in exchange withdrawals, some of which occurred after he first flagged the suspected crypto theft.

news.title: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June
news.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF shed $405.3 million on Monday as US spot Bitcoin funds opened November with nearly $399 million in net outflows.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
news.summary: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

news.title: Bitcoin miner Cipher posts $31 million profit as AI pivot begins
news.summary: The company's revenue dropped 63% in the third quarter, while a $127 million accounting gain helped turn an operating loss into a reported profit.

news.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
news.summary: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

news.title: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes
news.summary: Crypto.com will discontinue its consumer app services in Hong Kong in February next year.

news.title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
news.summary: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.

news.title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark rate to 4.85% on rising technology costs from AI investment and higher energy prices.

news.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
news.summary: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.

news.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
news.summary: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Sunday.

news.title: Ark Invest buys $3.4 million in Coinbase, adds Circle and Robinhood as stocks trade lower
news.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $3.4 million of Coinbase shares, $2.6 million of Circle, and $645,820 of Robinhood on Monday.

news.title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
news.summary: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.

news.title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
news.summary: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.

news.title: Kim Jong-Un’s sister rejects FBI claims linking North Korea to record $6 billion Binance hack: reports
news.summary: North Korea is now reportedly saying it was not behind the hack, despite the FBI finding that North Korean hackers were behind the heist.

news.title: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto’s midterm test
news.summary: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.

news.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
news.summary: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.

news.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
news.summary: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

news.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
news.summary: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.

news.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
news.summary: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin, Brazil’s largest crypto exchange, hit by $46 million security breach
news.summary: Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin confirmed earlier Monday a security incident and paused withdrawals.

news.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
news.summary: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.

news.title: DTCC’s tokenization launch could accelerate adoption and boost Securitize, StoneX says
news.summary: StoneX says DTCC's tokenization service validates Securitize's model, reiterating its buy rating on SECZ as the firm expands tokenized stocks.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
news.summary: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.

news.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
news.summary: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

news.title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
news.summary: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.

news.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
news.summary: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

news.title: Binance completes latest proof of reserves as it works to restore assets, withdrawals after record hack
news.summary: Binance users can now independently verify 1:1 backing for BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP and more as it replenishes 95% of assets lost in record hack.

news.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
news.summary: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

news.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
news.summary: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

news.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
news.summary: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

news.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
news.summary: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

news.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
news.summary: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

news.title: Strive inches closer to becoming second-largest public bitcoin holder after latest $10 million buy
news.summary: Strive bought another 124 BTC, bringing it closer to becoming the second-largest public company holder of bitcoin after Strategy.

news.title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
news.summary: Regardless of how the midterm elections unfold or which party secures the presidency in 2028, our industry must adhere to its established playbook, writes Solana Policy Institute’s Colin McLaren.

news.title: Bitmine adds 8,573 ETH as Tom Lee flags muted Binance hack reaction
news.summary: Bitmine added 8,573 ETH last week, lifting holdings to 6.06 million ETH, as Tom Lee flagged muted market response to Binance's hack.

news.title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
news.summary: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.

news.title: Tokenization firm tZERO plans to go public in $350 million SPAC deal
news.summary: The digital securities firm plans to list on NYSE American under TZRO early next year after more than a decade building blockchain-based trading infrastructure.

news.title: Strategy spends triple its weekly Bitcoin outlay on STRC buybacks
news.summary: Strategy spent $208.2 million buying back STRC preferred shares and $65.5 million on Bitcoin, while allocating $98.5 million to its USD Cash balance.

news.title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
news.summary: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.

news.title: Binance taps half its SAFU Bitcoin holdings, releases reserve proof
news.summary: Binance’s SAFU Bitcoin wallet now holds about 7,500 BTC after a 7,499 BTC transfer linked to the hack, with no timeline for restoring the $1 billion fund.

news.title: ‘We found room for even more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy scoops up another 811 bitcoin for $65.5 million
news.summary: The latest bitcoin acquisition disclosure comes after Strategy reported $19.5 billion in third quarter net income on Thursday.

news.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
news.summary: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.

news.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
news.summary: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.

news.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
news.summary: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

news.title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 2, 2026

news.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.

news.title: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?
news.summary: Bitcoin lost 7.3% in October 2026 after another decline the previous year, despite the month’s historically strong returns, as analysts reassess seasonal signals.

news.title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
news.summary: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.

news.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
news.summary: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

news.title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 2.

news.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs see largest daily outflows in four months following record Binance hack
news.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs shed $643 million on Friday, marking their largest single-day outflow since June 25, following Thursday's Binance's hack.

news.title: North Korean hackers launder $242 million of Binance loot via Tron as FBI presses THORChain: analyst
news.summary: Crypto bridges Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis moved about $140 million of stolen funds off Tron, with Relay handling the most at $48 million.

news.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack
news.summary: The exchange said the outflows equal 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets and that withdrawal volumes have declined after an initial spike.

news.title: Hackers hijack a dozen DeFi websites, all registered with Name.com, and steal about $138,000
news.summary: All 12 hijacked domains are registered through Name.com, according to registry records accessed by The Block, suggesting a compromise.

news.title: Chainalysis says hacker using ‘offensive agentic techniques’ accessed its customers’ names and emails
news.summary: The firm has also been tracking Binance’s separate multibillion-dollar hack, and said the attackers are using a Tron protocol to dodge stablecoin freezes.

news.title: Inside the largest crypto hack on record: How attackers breached Binance for $6.3 billion
news.summary: Investigators tie the $6B Binance hack to North Korea. Here's how hot-wallet signing infrastructure was compromised and where funds went.

news.title: President Trump says they’re looking into Binance hack as calls grow for crypto rules
news.summary: Following the $6.3 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange, Binance, calls are growing for legislation.

news.title: Texas brothers sentenced to 15 years for holding Minnesota family at gunpoint in $8 million crypto heist
news.summary: Two brothers who held a family for nine hours at gunpoint in Minnesota for $8 million worth of cryptocurrency were sentenced on Friday.

news.title: Strategy’s preferred-stock fix sets up renewed bitcoin buying, analysts say
news.summary: Strategy fell after Q3 earnings, but StoneX & TD Cowen kept buy ratings, citing $4.83B cash reserve and more stable STRC preferred structure.

news.title: Binance says it has $6.34 billion ready to cover hack losses
news.summary: Binance has allocated $6.34 billion to cover hack losses, while industry partners have frozen another $3 billion in affected assets.
